headline: US Project Vault Secures $12B Critical Minerals Stockpile
summary: President Trump announced Project Vault, a $12 billion strategic stockpile of critical minerals and rare earths supported by a $10 billion U.S. Export-Import Bank loan.
why: Strategic mineral stockpiles aim to secure supply chains for defense and manufacturing industries, mitigating geopolitical risks and vulnerabilities to foreign export restrictions.

impacts.name: Rare Earths & Critical Minerals
impacts.why: Project Vault establishes a strategic stockpile backed by a $12 billion initiative.
